title: FeatureBundle
description: V2: combined [quant + news] feature matrix for the cross-sectional decision model at one as_of. One entry per ticker in the universe. EARLY FUSION: quant and news features are concatenated here, before the decision model, so it can learn their interactions. All features are past-only (no lookahead).

universe.description: Tickers ranked together (cross-section needs a universe, not one name).

quant_features.description: Ordered quant feature names; align with entries[].quant.

news_features.description: Ordered news feature names (from llm_analysis); align with entries[].news.

cross_sectional_normalized.description: True if features are already cross-sectionally standardized across the universe at as_of.

news.description: Aligns to feature_spec.news_features; zeros if no news.

valid.description: False if required data was missing for this ticker (exclude from ranking).
